_comment: Shown on the dashboard after an update: the versions newer than the one this browser last saw, newest first. Add an entry with each release, in the version bump. A few short lines each; the full notes are on the release page.

items: Two new themes: Harbour, where every device is a container on the quay, and Ant Farm, where every device has a chamber in the nest.
This note: after an update, BAMF says what changed. The version in the header shows it any time.
On a phone, the Activity tab no longer slides sideways.
Settings is in seven sections, picked from a list down the side, with a box to find any setting.
Each section has its own address, such as /#settings/internet.
Appearance has a Theme row, beside Holiday Spirit and Night mode.
A device's ⋯ menu is grouped: About this device, Wiring, Look closer and Status.
Scan ▾ in the header: sweep every network or one right now, scan ports, or run the health check.
Test beside your saved webhook in Settings, in place of Tools → Test webhook.
The hygiene card's Check now is the Scan menu's Health check.
A scheduled speed test that fails, say just after the machine wakes, is tried twice more within the hour.
Speed test: download, upload and ping against Cloudflare, from Run now on the Internet card or on a schedule.
A month of tests is charted, and a scheduled test well under your usual is an Internet alert.
Spring and Summer have ground of their own along the bottom, clear of the table, and are a shade softer.
Data Centre has a hologram of your network, a shuttle with a scan laser, and readouts on the patch panel.
